ActorTalk: Back then, being here was an honor, but I also felt the weight of it.
I prepared. Trained hard. Did everything I could. Still felt like I might come up short.
From where I stand, you've never fallen short.
You're tougher on yourself than anyone else is.
Having you here by my side now, most of that pressure is just gone.
Because I know you've got my back. Always have.
